tagline: A voice store agent for WooCommerce owners, with an AG Studio Money Desk on PayPal data

steps.text: Small shop owners take payments with PayPal, but refunds, disputes and unpaid invoices live in five different screens. Tillwise is a store agent they can simply talk to.
Good morning, how's the shop doing today?
Money never moves on a guess. The PayPal refund is previewed first, and nothing happens until the owner confirms.
Under the hood, every MCP tool call is visible: preview, confirmation, then the PayPal apply call and its audit row.

This is the Money Desk, built inside AG Studio. Built-in charts and grids sit next to three custom widgets: refund rate, who still owes us, and dispute deadlines. All of it is read from PayPal through our MCP server.

Studio's AI panel runs on the GitHub Copilot SDK. The model reads a read-only refund anomaly tool, quotes its figures, and adds a chart of refunds per day by reason, so the damaged mug shipments stand out against the weeks before.
The Studio agent has no money-moving tools at all, so it declines and points back to the confirmed voice flow.
Tillwise and PayPal. Talk to your shop, see your money, and stay in control of every refund.
